newsitem.title: USA: Florida investor holds patent on belted condom.
newsitem.headline: Florida investor holds patent on belted condom.

text.p: A Florida courier has patented a belted condom aimed at preventing slippage during intercourse, a local newspaper reported on Friday.
Ray Bell, 35, from Tallahassee, told the Tallahassee Democrat the idea of a "non-slip" condom came to him after personal experience showed that condoms could become loose during sex.
He said he had no financial backers for his untested product but, with the rise of sexually transmitted diseases including AIDS, he believed the timing was perfect.
His invention consists of a flexible strap attached to a condom that is fastened around the waist or leg.
Local condom shop owner Kenneth Smith was sceptical and said while some customers raised concerns about condom size, few complained of slippage.
